name: Browser Tools
description: Host-neutral Agent browser loop with structured snapshots, ref actions, multi-page control, file bridge, console, and network inspection.
author: cognia-next

browser.reason: The embedded preview engine exists only in the desktop app. In a browser tab the tools work only while the remote Chromium engine is enabled and healthy; otherwise each call returns a browser_feature_unsupported error.

mobile.reason: The mobile app has no embedded preview engine. The tools drive the remote Chromium engine of a paired desktop or cloud host and return a browser_feature_unsupported error when it is not enabled and healthy.
